remarks:
Set on 13 breathtaking acres of private, meticulously curated grounds, this exceptional estate delivers a rare blend of refined luxury, thoughtful design, and lifestyle versatility.

From the moment you arrive, the property unfolds as a true retreat—where rolling land, three picturesque ponds stocked with koi and bass, and expansive open space create an atmosphere of peaceful seclusion and natural beauty. Every inch has been maintained with precision, offering a level of care and pride that is immediately evident.

Inside, the residence is designed for effortless elegance and seamless one-floor living, anchored by a luxurious first-floor primary suite that provides both comfort and privacy. The home features five spacious bedrooms and 3.5 beautifully appointed baths, each crafted with high-end finishes and timeless appeal.

At the heart of the home lies a chef’s kitchen of exceptional caliber, complete with premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and an adjoining butler’s pantry—perfectly suited for entertaining at scale or intimate gatherings alike. The living space is equally impressive, highlighted by a sophisticated wet bar, creating a warm, inviting setting for hosting and relaxation.

The lower level introduces an added dimension of flexibility with a fully equipped private ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit)—featuring its own entrance, a bedroom, full bath, and laundry—ideal for extended family, guests, or potential income opportunities.

A three-car attached garage offers both convenience and ample space, seamlessly integrated into the home’s design while complementing the estate’s functionality.

Outdoors, the estate continues to impress with two substantial barns—measuring 25x33 and 40x30—both designed for functionality and performance. The larger barn is outfitted with dual 12-foot overhead doors and radiant-heated concrete floors, making it an exceptional space for hobbyists, collectors, or business use.

This is more than a home—it is a lifestyle estate where luxury meets land, and every detail has been thoughtfully elevated. A truly rare offering for those seeking privacy, sophistication, and uncompromising quality.
